conformant_adapter: GKOS-Engine-Lite Rust, pin-bound and not a GKX authority

canonical_mapping.valid_to: accepted canonical projection invalidAt; public results recompute it over the authorization-scoped canonical edge view
canonical_mapping.lineage_id: null for the pinned current Standard profile; derived hosts cannot mint it

projection.missing_time: when both source created/modified stats are absent, manifest-bound projection_reference_time is required even if authored created_at exists; without it that intrinsic candidate is rejected before the single GkxIndex projection while unrelated candidates remain unchanged

as_of.grammar: existing GKX_TIMESTAMP_RE with optional seconds/fraction and mandatory explicit zone
as_of.future_candidate_rule: future candidates are removed silently before identity, endpoint, declaration, topology, or order checks and are indistinguishable from physical absence
as_of.unknown_candidate_rule: unknown candidates are removed before identity, endpoint, declaration, topology, or order checks and contribute only the authorization-scoped coverage-insufficient bit
as_of.conflict_precedence: RETRIEVAL_AUTHORIZED_VIEW_CONFLICT wins over TEMPORAL_COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT when a known-created authorized conflict coexists with unknown coverage
as_of.insufficient_rule: nonempty authorized and typed-filtered corpus with any unknown canonical interval or zero temporally valid sources

temporal_state.current: known canonical validity and invalidAt is null
temporal_state.historical: known canonical validity and invalidAt is non-null
temporal_state.future: excluded diagnostic relative to explicit as_of only; never a hit

provenance.relationship_endpoints: authorized resolved canonical UIDs that are not future at as_of; historical predecessors may remain visible from an eligible successor and future successors are suppressed
provenance.endpoint_suppression: silent; LINEAGE_VIEW_AUTHORIZED_ONLY is invariant and external lineage_neutral/participant state derives only from visible endpoint arrays

stored_provenance_invariants.title_bound: nonempty and at most 512 ECMAScript UTF-16 code units
stored_provenance_invariants.assertion_metadata_binding: assertion_time is non-null iff assertion_origin is gkx_created_at and source_metadata.authored_at is present; authored_at must equal assertion_time exactly; null assertion requires authored_at absent
stored_provenance_invariants.assertion_validity_binding: when assertion_time and valid_from are both non-null, validity_origin is gkx_authored_timestamp and valid_from equals assertion_time; gkx_authored_timestamp origin requires both values non-null and equal; assertion_time may remain non-null with null valid_from only when validity_origin and temporal_state are unknown
stored_provenance_invariants.canonical_timestamp: stored assertion_time, authored_at, valid_from, and valid_to are exact normalized four-digit-year UTC YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ values

physical_candidate_projection.identity: internal SHA-256 descriptor record_key plus multiplicity slot; never a public source or chunk identity
physical_candidate_projection.declaration_receipts: parser-owned raw declaration plus exact ordered canonical resolver-basis candidate record-key sets; trusted-host-only
physical_candidate_projection.projection_digest_binding: complete canonical candidate/declaration/chunk/vector/eligibility multiset, exact backend schema/tokenizer, Standard/profile/policy coordinates, and candidate-named counts

runtime_policy_digest: required and exactly equal to the schema-3 manifest policy_digest before callbacks or source/provider work

cross_record_topology_authority.scope: authorization-hidden canonical identity collisions, endpoint resolution, forward/inverse/conflicting declarations, and multiple-successor/cycle/temporal-order diagnostics
cross_record_topology_authority.authorized_view_rule: evaluate only after source policy, typed filters, whole-source chunk policy, and explicit-as_of future/unknown removal using parser-owned canonical candidate receipts and existing resolver precedence
cross_record_topology_authority.hidden_or_future_rule: authorization-hidden candidates are indistinguishable from physical absence; future candidates are silently suppressed
cross_record_topology_authority.conflict_disclosure: one code and message with no class, count, path, UID, reference, internal record key, or physical projection coordinate
cross_record_topology_authority.conflict_work_boundary: before live source reads, lexical/vector SQL, query embedding, reranking, ranking, result counts, confidence, citations, or parent expansion
cross_record_topology_authority.ordinary_link_rule: ordinary unresolved or ambiguous Markdown/wiki links retain existing non-conflicting link behavior; only lineage and governed typed-relationship declarations participate

result_budget: complete canonical UTF-8 serialized result envelope, winner-first; parent context is omitted before its winning child when the parent would exceed the budget
